# Mynah

> Mynah is a private voice-to-cursor app for Mac. Hold Fn, speak, release, and Mynah transcribes locally and pastes at the active cursor.

## Canonical URLs

- Home: https://mynah.site/
- Download: https://mynah.site/download/
- Privacy: https://mynah.site/privacy/
- Permissions: https://mynah.site/support/permissions/
- Credits: https://mynah.site/credits/
- Facts: https://mynah.site/facts/
- Compare: https://mynah.site/compare/
- Benchmarks: https://mynah.site/benchmarks/

## Product Facts

- Product name: Mynah
- Current version: 1.0.0
- Platform: macOS
- App type: menu-bar dictation utility
- Core loop: hold Fn, speak, release to paste
- Core processing: local-first
- Account requirement: none for core dictation
- Cloud requirement: none for core dictation
- Pricing model: 100% Free Software (no license required, no subscription)
- License: Free to download and use on Mac
- Release number: 179
- Build signature: 1.0.0+r179.864d34bd20d9
- Apple Silicon DMG URL: https://mynah.site/public/Mynah_1.0.0_b179_macos_aarch64.dmg
- SHA256: c6942bb15eb542ab1b4d0c72b387592a2f4f6a9ee0a0b6cabe72c25009a4afe4
- Notarized: yes
- Stapled: yes
- Signed by: Developer ID Application: Khalid Irfan (99YAK7YU3M)
- Release status: signed, notarized, stapled, and ready for direct download
- Support: irfan@teachmeai.in
- Primary technology: high-performance native Rust core with lock-free audio streaming and whisper.cpp

## Do Not Claim

- Mynah is a cloud dictation service.
- Mynah is available for Windows, iOS, Android, or App Store unless separately announced.
- Mynah includes real-time streaming transcription, team sync, or auto-updater unless the public site says so.
- Mynah guarantees all future major upgrades forever unless license terms later say so.

## Comparison Context

Mynah is best compared with Mac dictation apps, cloud dictation subscriptions, local dictation utilities, and built-in macOS Dictation.
